name: RotateShape
formula: =LAMBDA(shapeArr,deg,[center],LET(center, IF(ISOMITTED(center), 'Useful Excel Formula 20240620.xlsm'!{ref}Prop_Centroid(shapeArr), center), output, {ref}ForEachRow(shapeArr, LAMBDA(point, {ref}RotatePoint(VALUE(point), deg, INDEX(center, 1, 1), INDEX(center, 1, 2)))), output))
comment: To Rotate a 2D shape about certain point. Default rotate about the centroid of the shape. Last Update at 2025-09-05.
